title: 都说等通胀再降：RenMac却喊现在就加，9月窗口若关闭谁买单？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Neil Dutter of Ren Mac, not saying a reason to wait to hike rates. He writes the following, if you have one good month of inflation data but you know the next two months will be bad,
segments.zh: RenMac的Neil Dutter认为没有理由推迟加息。他写道：如果你有一个月通胀数据不错，但知道接下来两个月会很糟，那不如现在就行动。

segments.en: you might as well just do it now. Neil joins us now for more. Neil, provocative piece this week, appreciate your time and thanks for coming on. Walk us through the setup for next week and why you think tactically this might be the right window to hike rates.
segments.zh: Neil现在加入我们。Neil，你这周的文章很有争议，感谢你的时间。请谈谈下周的形势，以及为什么你认为从策略上看现在可能是加息的合适窗口。

segments.en: Well, I think following with what Mike said, the sort of checking of the boxes, I mean, I almost feel like guys, it's sort of hiding there in plain sight in the minutes, right?
segments.zh: 嗯，我同意Mike说的，各项条件都已具备。我几乎觉得，伙计们，这其实就明摆在会议纪要里，对吧？

segments.en: So you kind of have the AI demand piece. You know, we see that hyper-scaler CapEx continues to moonshot. You have the oil piece and while it's encouraging that oil is down today, I mean,
segments.zh: 所以有AI需求这块，我们看到超大规模资本支出仍在飙升。还有石油这块，虽然今天油价下跌令人鼓舞，但冲突似乎仍在持续。

segments.en: it does feel like the conflict is ongoing and so I think it's possible that that's fleeting, but we do know that no matter what gas prices probably go up into August. And you know,
segments.zh: 所以我觉得这种下跌可能是暂时的。但我们知道，无论如何，汽油价格到8月很可能会上涨。

segments.en: lastly, tariffs, the president is doing what the president does with tariffs. So it's kind of, you just go down the list. Now, if you're Kevin Warsh, I think it's important to go hike
segments.zh: 最后是关税，总统在做他该做的事。所以，你只需逐一审视。如果你是Kevin Warsh，我认为重要的是在有能力时加息，以保持对委员会的一定控制，而不是等到不得不加时再加。

segments.en: when you can and maintain some modicum of control over the committee then to hike when you must.
segments.zh: 而不是等到不得不加时再加。
